capabilities: Sync calendars two-way over CalDAV and iCloud
Display events in day, week and month views with drag and drop
Inject each day's events into the matching daily note
Skip or restore injected events in daily notes
extras: README is in Chinese. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation is manual: download main.js, manifest.json and styles.css from GitHub Releases into .obsidian/plugins/myagenda/. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or newer. Account credentials are stored locally in data.json and the README warns not to upload that file.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar that syncs with external CalDAV or iCloud calendars and can place scheduled events into daily notes.

relations.evidence: 支持 CalDAV / iCloud 双向同步

summary: Calendar plugin that two-way syncs CalDAV and iCloud calendars, shows day, week and month views, and injects events into daily notes.
